title: CRM
subtitle: End-to-End Customer Relationship & Revenue Pipeline Platform
description: Directed the product lifecycle for the enterprise CRM platform, standardizing lead qualification pipelines, deal stage progressions, and stakeholder communication records into a high-visibility revenue operations platform.
overview: The enterprise CRM platform was developed to solve commercial revenue visibility and sales pipeline bottlenecks at IE Networking Solutions. Serving as Product Owner and Business Analyst, I translated executive growth objectives, sales representative pain points, and customer success workflows into a scalable CRM platform.
challenge: Sales teams navigated disjointed customer communication histories, non-standardized deal qualification criteria, and manual pipeline tracking in spreadsheets. The absence of automated stage gates led to lead leakage and inaccurate revenue forecasting.
solution: Architected clear deal progression stages, validation rules, and automated contact interaction timelines. Authored comprehensive PRDs defining lead conversion criteria, role-based visibility, and custom reporting filters. Prototyped the interface using AI prototyping to ensure rapid user adoption and frictionless data entry for sales reps.

architecture.problem: Unstandardized sales tracking and fragmented customer records caused lost deals and unpredictable revenue forecasting.
architecture.tradeoffs: Designed a stage-gated pipeline state machine with mandatory validation criteria, balancing deep managerial visibility with low-friction rep data entry.
metricsDetail: Engineered standardized stage-gate deal progression criteria and lead qualification metrics
Drafted detailed functional specifications, business rules, and edge-case handling protocols
Designed wireframes and interactive UI prototypes with AI prototyping tailored for high-speed sales workflows
Aligned product scope with business executives, sales leaders, and engineering delivery squads
Delivered complete release documentation, training decks, and rollout user guides

outcomes: Standardized enterprise sales pipelines across all active commercial accounts.
Accelerated sales velocity by eliminating manual deal status updates and lost contact histories.
Achieved seamless cross-functional alignment between commercial teams and technical developers.
